id-20260930-news-1.title: 2027 State Budget Passed: Rp4,106 Trillion Spending, 6 Percent Growth, and Tests from Oil Prices and the Rupiah

segments.src: ## Ringkasan
segments.tr: ## Summary

segments.src: Rapat Paripurna DPR menyetujui Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) APBN 2027 menjadi undang-undang, dengan dukungan seluruh fraksi.
segments.tr: The DPR Plenary Meeting approved the 2027 State Budget (APBN) Bill into law, with the support of all factions.

segments.src: Belanja negara dipatok sekitar **Rp4.106 triliun**.
segments.tr: State spending is pegged at around **Rp4,106 trillion**.

segments.src: Asumsi makro utamanya adalah **pertumbuhan ekonomi 6 persen** dan **inflasi 2,5 persen**.
segments.tr: The main macroeconomic assumptions are **6 percent economic growth** and **2.5 percent inflation**.

segments.src: Pertanyaannya sekarang bukan lagi apakah anggaran itu disahkan, tetapi apakah angka-angka tersebut bisa dipertahankan ketika harga minyak tinggi dan nilai tukar rupiah melemah.
segments.tr: The question now is no longer whether the budget is passed, but whether these figures can be maintained when oil prices are high and the rupiah exchange rate weakens.

segments.src: > Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan nasihat investasi atau keuangan. Angka yang dikutip mengacu pada informasi yang disampaikan dalam pengesahan. Rincian resmi selalu dapat diperiksa pada dokumen undang-undang dan publikasi Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for informational purposes and is not investment or financial advice. The figures cited refer to the information presented during the enactment. Official details can always be checked in the statutory documents and publications of the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Disahkan
segments.tr: ## What Was Passed

segments.src: APBN adalah rencana keuangan tahunan pemerintah yang memuat pendapatan negara, belanja negara, dan pembiayaan.
segments.tr: The APBN is the government's annual financial plan containing state revenues, state spending, and financing.

segments.src: Undang-undang ini menjadi dasar hukum bagi pemerintah untuk memungut penerimaan dan membelanjakan anggaran sepanjang tahun anggaran.
segments.tr: This law serves as the legal basis for the government to collect revenues and spend the budget throughout the fiscal year.

segments.src: Poin-poin utama dari pengesahan APBN 2027:
segments.tr: Key points from the enactment of the 2027 APBN:

segments.src: - **Belanja negara** sekitar Rp4.106 triliun.
segments.tr: - **State spending** of around Rp4,106 trillion.

segments.src: - **Pertumbuhan ekonomi** diasumsikan 6 persen.
segments.tr: - **Economic growth** is assumed at 6 percent.

segments.src: - **Inflasi** diasumsikan 2,5 persen.
segments.tr: - **Inflation** is assumed at 2.5 percent.

segments.src: - **Persetujuan** diberikan oleh seluruh fraksi di DPR dalam rapat paripurna.
segments.tr: - **Approval** was granted by all factions in the DPR during the plenary meeting.

segments.src: Dukungan bulat dari seluruh fraksi menunjukkan bahwa proses pembahasan antara pemerintah dan DPR berjalan tanpa penolakan di tahap akhir.
segments.tr: The unanimous support from all factions shows that the discussion process between the government and the DPR ran without rejection in the final stage.

segments.src: Namun, kesepakatan politik di atas kertas tidak otomatis menjamin pelaksanaan yang mulus di lapangan.
segments.tr: However, political agreements on paper do not automatically guarantee smooth implementation in the field.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Asumsi Makro Penting
segments.tr: ## Why Macro Assumptions Matter

segments.src: Asumsi makro adalah "pijakan" penyusunan anggaran.
segments.tr: Macro assumptions are the "foundation" of budget preparation.

segments.src: Beberapa di antaranya berpengaruh langsung terhadap angka penerimaan dan belanja:
segments.tr: Several of them directly affect revenue and spending figures:

segments.src: 1. **Pertumbuhan ekonomi.** Semakin tinggi pertumbuhan, semakin besar basis pajak, mulai dari pajak penghasilan hingga pajak konsumsi. Target 6 persen tergolong ambisius dan membutuhkan investasi serta konsumsi yang kuat.
segments.tr: 1. **Economic growth.** The higher the growth, the larger the tax base, ranging from income tax to consumption tax. The 6 percent target is considered ambitious and requires strong investment and consumption.

segments.src: 2. **Inflasi.** Inflasi yang terkendali menjaga daya beli masyarakat dan memudahkan perencanaan belanja. Target 2,5 persen menuntut stabilitas harga pangan dan energi.
segments.tr: 2. **Inflation.** Controlled inflation maintains people's purchasing power and facilitates budget planning. The 2.5 percent target demands food and energy price stability.

segments.src: 3. **Nilai tukar rupiah.** Pelemahan rupiah dapat menaikkan biaya impor, termasuk energi, serta beban pembayaran utang dalam mata uang asing.
segments.tr: 3. **Rupiah exchange rate.** The weakening of the rupiah can increase import costs, including energy, as well as the burden of foreign currency debt payments.

segments.src: 4. **Harga minyak.** Harga minyak dunia memengaruhi penerimaan negara dari sektor migas sekaligus beban subsidi dan kompensasi energi.
segments.tr: 4. **Oil prices.** World oil prices affect state revenues from the oil and gas sector as well as the burden of energy subsidies and compensation.

segments.src: ## Dua Risiko yang Disorot: Minyak dan Rupiah
segments.tr: ## Two Risks Highlighted: Oil and the Rupiah

segments.src: ### Harga minyak yang tinggi
segments.tr: ### High oil prices

segments.src: Indonesia merupakan pengimpor bersih minyak.
segments.tr: Indonesia is a net oil importer.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak naik, biaya impor meningkat, dan tekanan pada subsidi serta kompensasi energi bisa bertambah jika harga jual di dalam negeri ditahan.
segments.tr: When oil prices rise, import costs increase, and pressure on energy subsidies and compensation can grow if domestic selling prices are held back.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, kenaikan harga minyak dapat mendorong penerimaan dari sektor hulu migas, tetapi efek bersihnya umumnya tidak sebesar tambahan beban belanja.
segments.tr: On the other hand, rising oil prices can boost revenues from the upstream oil and gas sector, but the net effect is generally not as large as the additional spending burden.

segments.src: ### Rupiah yang melemah
segments.tr: ### A weakening rupiah

segments.src: Rupiah yang lemah berdampak ganda.
segments.tr: A weak rupiah has a dual impact.

segments.src: Pertama, harga barang impor, termasuk bahan baku industri, cenderung naik sehingga berpotensi mendorong inflasi melampaui target.
segments.tr: First, the prices of imported goods, including industrial raw materials, tend to rise, potentially pushing inflation beyond the target.

segments.src: Kedua, pembayaran bunga dan pokok utang berdenominasi valuta asing menjadi lebih mahal.
segments.tr: Second, foreign currency-denominated debt interest and principal payments become more expensive.

segments.src: Bagi dunia usaha, biaya produksi yang meningkat dapat menahan laju investasi.
segments.tr: For businesses, increased production costs can hold back the pace of investment.

segments.src: ### Keterkaitan keduanya
segments.tr: ### The link between the two

segments.src: Kedua risiko ini saling memperkuat.
segments.tr: These two risks reinforce each other.

segments.src: Harga minyak yang tinggi meningkatkan kebutuhan devisa untuk impor energi, yang dapat menambah tekanan pada rupiah.
segments.tr: High oil prices increase foreign exchange demand for energy imports, which can add pressure on the rupiah.

segments.src: Rupiah yang lebih lemah kemudian membuat harga minyak dalam rupiah terasa lebih mahal.
segments.tr: A weaker rupiah then makes oil prices in rupiah feel more expensive.

segments.src: Jika inflasi ikut naik, ruang kebijakan moneter untuk menopang pertumbuhan menjadi lebih sempit.
segments.tr: If inflation also rises, the monetary policy space to support growth becomes narrower.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Menuju Pertumbuhan 6 Persen
segments.tr: ## Challenges Toward 6 Percent Growth

segments.src: Mencapai pertumbuhan 6 persen bukan hanya soal besarnya belanja negara.
segments.tr: Achieving 6 percent growth is not just about the size of state spending.

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang biasanya menentukan:
segments.tr: Several factors usually determine this:

segments.src: - **Kualitas belanja.** Anggaran yang besar perlu diarahkan pada program yang menghasilkan dampak nyata, seperti infrastruktur, pendidikan, kesehatan, dan penciptaan lapangan kerja.
segments.tr: - **Spending quality.** Large budgets need to be directed toward programs that produce real impacts, such as infrastructure, education, health, and job creation.

segments.src: - **Investasi swasta.** Kepastian regulasi dan iklim usaha menentukan apakah dunia usaha bersedia menambah investasi.
segments.tr: - **Private investment.** Regulatory certainty and the business climate determine whether the business world is willing to increase investment.

segments.src: - **Konsumsi rumah tangga.** Sebagai penyumbang terbesar produk domestik bruto, konsumsi bergantung pada daya beli, yang erat kaitannya dengan inflasi dan penghasilan.
segments.tr: - **Household consumption.** As the largest contributor to gross domestic product, consumption depends on purchasing power, which is closely related to inflation and income.

segments.src: - **Kondisi global.** Perlambatan ekonomi dunia, ketegangan geopolitik, dan suku bunga global memengaruhi arus modal dan permintaan ekspor.
segments.tr: - **Global conditions.** World economic slowdown, geopolitical tensions, and global interest rates affect capital flows and export demand.

segments.src: ## Disiplin Fiskal dan Ruang Manuver
segments.tr: ## Fiscal Discipline and Room for Maneuver

segments.src: Belanja yang besar menuntut penerimaan yang memadai.
segments.tr: Large spending demands adequate revenue.

segments.src: Jika penerimaan tidak sesuai target, pemerintah dapat menghadapi pilihan sulit: menambah pembiayaan melalui utang, menunda sebagian belanja, atau menyesuaikan prioritas program.
segments.tr: If revenues do not meet the target, the government may face difficult choices: increasing financing through debt, delaying some spending, or adjusting program priorities.

segments.src: Karena itu, banyak pengamat menekankan pentingnya menjaga kredibilitas fiskal, yaitu konsistensi antara rencana dan realisasi, agar kepercayaan pasar tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: Therefore, many observers emphasize the importance of maintaining fiscal credibility, namely consistency between plans and realization, so that market confidence is maintained.

segments.src: Undang-undang APBN juga lazim memberi ruang penyesuaian melalui mekanisme perubahan anggaran atau pergeseran antarpos bila kondisi berubah signifikan.
segments.tr: The APBN Law also customarily provides room for adjustment through budget amendment mechanisms or shifts between posts if conditions change significantly.

segments.src: Hal ini menjadi bantalan ketika asumsi awal meleset.
segments.tr: This serves as a cushion when initial assumptions miss the mark.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## What It Means for the Public

segments.src: Bagi warga dan pelaku usaha, beberapa hal berikut layak dicermati sepanjang tahun anggaran:
segments.tr: For citizens and business actors, the following points are worth watching throughout the fiscal year:

segments.src: - **Harga kebutuhan pokok dan energi.** Perkembangan harga minyak dan kurs akan memengaruhi biaya hidup.
segments.tr: - **Basic needs and energy prices.** Developments in oil prices and exchange rates will affect the cost of living.

segments.src: - **Program pemerintah.** Realisasi belanja pada sektor yang bersentuhan langsung dengan masyarakat menentukan manfaat yang dirasakan.
segments.tr: - **Government programs.** The realization of spending in sectors that directly touch the community determines the benefits felt.

segments.src: - **Suku bunga dan kredit.** Respons kebijakan moneter terhadap inflasi dan kurs dapat memengaruhi biaya pinjaman.
segments.tr: - **Interest rates and credit.** The monetary policy response to inflation and exchange rates can affect borrowing costs.

segments.src: - **Peluang usaha.** Belanja pemerintah yang terarah bisa membuka peluang bagi sektor konstruksi, pangan, kesehatan, dan teknologi.
segments.tr: - **Business opportunities.** Targeted government spending can open opportunities for the construction, food, health, and technology sectors.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dipantau Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## What to Monitor Next

segments.src: - Perkembangan harga minyak dunia dan kebijakan harga energi domestik.
segments.tr: - Developments in world oil prices and domestic energy price policies.

segments.src: - Pergerakan nilai tukar rupiah serta langkah stabilisasi dari otoritas terkait.
segments.tr: - Movements in the rupiah exchange rate and stabilization steps from relevant authorities.

segments.src: - Laporan realisasi APBN yang dipublikasikan secara berkala oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: - APBN realization reports published periodically by the government.

segments.src: - Data inflasi bulanan dan pertumbuhan ekonomi per kuartal dari lembaga statistik resmi.
segments.tr: - Monthly inflation data and quarterly economic growth from official statistical agencies.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Pengesahan APBN 2027 dengan dukungan seluruh fraksi memberi kepastian hukum bagi pemerintah untuk mulai menjalankan program tahun depan.
segments.tr: The enactment of the 2027 APBN with the support of all factions provides legal certainty for the government to start running next year's programs.

segments.src: Namun, angka belanja Rp4.106 triliun serta asumsi pertumbuhan 6 persen dan inflasi 2,5 persen baru akan terbukti realistis lewat pelaksanaannya.
segments.tr: However, the Rp4,106 trillion spending figure as well as the 6 percent growth and 2.5 percent inflation assumptions will only prove realistic through their implementation.

segments.src: Harga minyak yang tinggi dan rupiah yang lemah akan menjadi ujian pertama bagi ketahanan asumsi tersebut.
segments.tr: High oil prices and a weak rupiah will be the first test for the resilience of these assumptions.

segments.src: Publik disarankan mengikuti data resmi dan laporan realisasi anggaran untuk menilai perkembangannya secara objektif.
segments.tr: The public is advised to follow official data and budget realization reports to assess developments objectively.

id-20260930-news-2.title: Rupiah Touches Rp18,000 per USD, IHSG Tests 6,000 Level: What Investors Need to Watch

segments.src: Pasar keuangan domestik mengalami tekanan pada perdagangan Selasa (29/9).
segments.tr: Domestic financial markets experienced pressure during Tuesday's (9/29) trading.

segments.src: Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup di level 6.121 setelah sempat turun hingga 6.013 di tengah sesi.
segments.tr: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at the 6,121 level after dropping as low as 6,013 mid-session.

segments.src: Pada saat yang sama, nilai tukar rupiah sempat menembus Rp18.000 per dolar AS sebelum ditutup di Rp17.960.
segments.tr: At the same time, the rupiah exchange rate briefly breached Rp18,000 per USD before closing at Rp17,960.

segments.src: Pergerakan ini membuat banyak investor kembali memperhatikan dua level psikologis: 6.000 untuk IHSG dan Rp18.000 untuk rupiah.
segments.tr: This movement has brought many investors back to focusing on two psychological levels: 6,000 for the IHSG and Rp18,000 for the rupiah.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum apa yang terjadi, faktor pendorongnya, serta hal-hal yang layak dicermati.
segments.tr: This article summarizes what happened, the driving factors, and things worth watching.

segments.src: Tulisan ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan rekomendasi investasi.
segments.tr: This writing is of general information and not an investment recommendation.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan Pergerakan Pasar
segments.tr: ## Market Movement Summary

segments.src: | Indikator | Level penting |
segments.tr: | Indicator | Important Level |

segments.src: | IHSG (penutupan) | 6.121 |
segments.tr: | IHSG (closing) | 6,121 |

segments.src: | IHSG (terendah intraday) | 6.013 |
segments.tr: | IHSG (intraday low) | 6,013 |

segments.src: | Rupiah (sempat menyentuh) | di atas Rp18.000 per dolar AS |
segments.tr: | Rupiah (briefly touched) | above Rp18,000 per USD |

segments.src: | Rupiah (penutupan) | Rp17.960 per dolar AS |
segments.tr: | Rupiah (closing) | Rp17,960 per USD |

segments.src: Fakta bahwa IHSG mampu menjauh dari titik terendah hariannya menunjukkan adanya minat beli di area 6.000.
segments.tr: The fact that the IHSG was able to move away from its daily low indicates buying interest in the 6,000 area.

segments.src: Rupiah pun kembali ke bawah Rp18.000 saat penutupan.
segments.tr: The rupiah also returned below Rp18,000 at the close.

segments.src: Meski demikian, kedua indikator masih berada dalam zona sensitif.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, both indicators remain in the sensitive zone.

segments.src: ## Dua Tekanan Utama
segments.tr: ## Two Main Pressures

segments.src: ### 1. Harga minyak yang tinggi
segments.tr: ### 1. High oil prices

segments.src: Indonesia merupakan importir neto minyak.
segments.tr: Indonesia is a net oil importer.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak dunia bertahan tinggi, kebutuhan dolar AS untuk impor energi ikut meningkat.
segments.tr: When world oil prices remain high, the need for USD for energy imports also increases.

segments.src: Dampaknya bisa terasa pada beberapa sisi:
segments.tr: The impact can be felt on several sides:

segments.src: - **Neraca perdagangan dan transaksi berjalan**: beban impor energi yang lebih besar dapat menekan pasokan valuta asing.
segments.tr: - **Trade balance and current account**: larger energy import burdens can pressure foreign exchange supplies.

segments.src: - **Subsidi dan anggaran**: harga minyak tinggi berpotensi menambah beban subsidi energi dan kompensasi.
segments.tr: - **Subsidies and budget**: high oil prices have the potential to add to the burden of energy subsidies and compensation.

segments.src: - **Inflasi**: kenaikan biaya energi dan transportasi dapat merembet ke harga barang lain.
segments.tr: - **Inflation**: increases in energy and transportation costs can spill over into the prices of other goods.

segments.src: ### 2. Imbal hasil obligasi AS
segments.tr: ### 2. US bond yields

segments.src: Kenaikan imbal hasil (yield) obligasi pemerintah AS membuat aset berdenominasi dolar lebih menarik.
segments.tr: The increase in US government bond yields makes dollar-denominated assets more attractive.

segments.src: Akibatnya, arus modal cenderung bergeser dari pasar negara berkembang, termasuk Indonesia.
segments.tr: As a result, capital flows tend to shift from emerging markets, including Indonesia.

segments.src: Pelemahan mata uang dan tekanan jual di pasar saham serta obligasi domestik sering menyertai kondisi seperti ini.
segments.tr: Currency depreciation and selling pressure in domestic stock and bond markets often accompany conditions like this.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Level 6.000 dan Rp18.000 Penting
segments.tr: ## Why the 6,000 and Rp18,000 Levels Are Important

segments.src: Level bulat seperti ini umumnya dipandang sebagai batas psikologis.
segments.tr: Round levels like this are generally viewed as psychological limits.

segments.src: Pelaku pasar biasanya memantau apakah level tersebut bertahan atau tertembus, karena dapat memengaruhi sentimen dan keputusan transaksi.
segments.tr: Market participants usually monitor whether those levels hold or are breached, as they can influence sentiment and transaction decisions.

segments.src: Namun, level teknikal bukan jaminan arah pergerakan berikutnya; data ekonomi, kebijakan bank sentral, dan sentimen global tetap menjadi penentu utama.
segments.tr: However, technical levels are not a guarantee of the next movement direction; economic data, central bank policies, and global sentiment remain the main determinants.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Dicermati Investor
segments.tr: ## Things Investors Need to Watch

segments.src: 1. **Arah harga minyak dunia**: apakah tetap tinggi atau mulai mereda.
segments.tr: 1. **World oil price direction**: whether they remain high or begin to ease.

segments.src: 2. **Yield obligasi AS dan sinyal kebijakan The Fed**: menentukan daya tarik aset dolar.
segments.tr: 2. **US bond yields and The Fed policy signals**: determining the appeal of dollar assets.

segments.src: 3. **Langkah Bank Indonesia**: intervensi di pasar valas dan obligasi, serta arah suku bunga acuan.
segments.tr: 3. **Bank Indonesia steps**: intervention in the forex and bond markets, as well as the benchmark interest rate direction.

segments.src: 4. **Aliran dana asing**: posisi jual atau beli bersih investor asing di saham dan obligasi.
segments.tr: 4. **Foreign fund flows**: foreign investor net sell or buy positions in stocks and bonds.

segments.src: 5. **Data domestik**: inflasi, neraca perdagangan, dan cadangan devisa.
segments.tr: 5. **Domestic data**: inflation, trade balance, and foreign exchange reserves.

segments.src: 6. **Sektor yang sensitif**: perusahaan dengan utang dolar atau bahan baku impor cenderung lebih terdampak pelemahan rupiah, sedangkan eksportir komoditas bisa relatif diuntungkan.
segments.tr: 6. **Sensitive sectors**: companies with dollar debt or imported raw materials tend to be more impacted by rupiah depreciation, while commodity exporters can be relatively benefited.

segments.src: ## Catatan Manajemen Risiko
segments.tr: ## Risk Management Notes

segments.src: Dalam kondisi volatil, investor umumnya disarankan untuk:
segments.tr: In volatile conditions, investors are generally advised to:

segments.src: - menyesuaikan porsi aset sesuai profil risiko dan tujuan jangka panjang;
segments.tr: - adjust asset portions according to risk profiles and long-term goals;

segments.src: - menghindari keputusan yang semata-mata didorong kepanikan atau euforia;
segments.tr: - avoid decisions driven solely by panic or euphoria;

segments.src: - melakukan diversifikasi antaraset dan sektor;
segments.tr: - diversify across assets and sectors;

segments.src: - memastikan dana darurat tersedia sebelum menambah eksposur ke aset berisiko;
segments.tr: - ensure emergency funds are available before adding exposure to risky assets;

segments.src: - mengandalkan sumber informasi resmi, seperti data Bank Indonesia, Bursa Efek Indonesia, dan OJK.
segments.tr: - rely on official information sources, such as Bank Indonesia data, the Indonesia Stock Exchange, and the OJK.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Penutupan IHSG di 6.121 dan rupiah di Rp17.960 menunjukkan pasar masih mampu bertahan di tengah tekanan, tetapi ruang gerak tetap sempit.
segments.tr: The IHSG closing at 6,121 and the rupiah at Rp17,960 show the market is still able to survive amid pressure, but movement space remains narrow.

segments.src: Harga minyak dan imbal hasil obligasi AS akan menjadi variabel kunci dalam beberapa hari ke depan.
segments.tr: Oil prices and US bond yields will be key variables in the next few days.

segments.src: Investor sebaiknya memantau perkembangan tersebut dengan tenang dan mengambil keputusan berdasarkan analisis serta profil risiko masing-masing.
segments.tr: Investors should monitor these developments calmly and make decisions based on respective analysis and risk profiles.

id-20260930-news-3.title: Brent Hits US$108 per Barrel: The Chain Reaction of Global Oil Prices on Indonesia's Energy Subsidies and Logistics Costs

segments.src: Harga minyak mentah Brent naik sekitar 4 persen ke kisaran US$108,50 per barel.
segments.tr: Brent crude oil prices rose by about 4 percent to the range of US$108.50 per barrel.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, yang berstatus importir neto minyak, kenaikan ini bukan sekadar angka di layar perdagangan.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, which is a net oil importer, this increase is not just a number on a trading screen.

segments.src: Ada rantai dampak yang bergerak dari anggaran negara hingga ongkos kirim barang di pasar.
segments.tr: There is a chain of impacts moving from the state budget to the cost of shipping goods in the market.

segments.src: Tulisan ini menguraikan jalur dampak tersebut secara ringkas dan apa yang perlu dicermati ke depan.
segments.tr: This article briefly outlines these impact pathways and what needs to be watched moving forward.

segments.src: ## Mengapa harga minyak dunia berpengaruh besar bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## Why global oil prices have a major impact on Indonesia

segments.src: Sejak lama Indonesia tidak lagi menjadi eksportir neto minyak.
segments.tr: For a long time, Indonesia has no longer been a net oil exporter.

segments.src: Produksi domestik belum mampu menutup kebutuhan konsumsi, sehingga sebagian besar bahan bakar minyak (BBM) dan LPG dipenuhi dari impor.
segments.tr: Domestic production has not been able to meet consumption needs, so most fuel oil (BBM) and LPG are met through imports.

segments.src: Akibatnya, harga acuan internasional seperti Brent ikut menentukan biaya yang harus ditanggung negara dan pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: As a result, international benchmark prices like Brent help determine the costs that must be borne by the state and business players.

segments.src: Dua hal yang paling terasa adalah:
segments.tr: The two most noticeable things are:

segments.src: 1. **Beban subsidi dan kompensasi energi** dalam Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN).
segments.tr: 1. **Energy subsidy and compensation burden** in the State Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBN).

segments.src: 2. **Biaya angkutan dan logistik** yang bergantung pada solar dan bahan bakar lainnya.
segments.tr: 2. **Transportation and logistics costs** that depend on diesel and other fuels.

segments.src: ## Jalur pertama: tekanan pada subsidi energi
segments.tr: ## First pathway: pressure on energy subsidies

segments.src: Dalam APBN, asumsi harga minyak mentah Indonesia (Indonesian Crude Price/ICP) menjadi dasar perhitungan subsidi dan kompensasi.
segments.tr: In the APBN, the Indonesian Crude Price (ICP) assumption becomes the basis for calculating subsidies and compensation.

segments.src: ICP bergerak mengikuti tren harga minyak dunia dengan selisih tertentu.
segments.tr: The ICP moves according to global oil price trends with a certain margin.

segments.src: Ketika harga pasar berada jauh di atas asumsi, ada beberapa konsekuensi:
segments.tr: When market prices are far above the assumptions, there are several consequences:

segments.src: - **Subsidi solar dan LPG 3 kilogram membengkak.** Pemerintah menetapkan harga jual eceran di bawah harga keekonomian. Semakin tinggi harga dunia, semakin lebar selisih yang ditutup negara.
segments.tr: - **Subsidies for diesel and 3-kilogram LPG swell.** The government sets retail selling prices below economic prices. The higher the global price, the wider the gap that the state must cover.

segments.src: - **Kompensasi kepada badan usaha** seperti Pertamina bisa meningkat bila harga jual BBM tertentu ditahan di bawah harga keekonomian.
segments.tr: - **Compensation to business entities** such as Pertamina can increase if the selling prices of certain fuels are held below economic prices.

segments.src: - **Ruang fiskal menyempit.** Anggaran yang terserap untuk energi berarti berkurang untuk pos lain, atau defisit berpotensi melebar.
segments.tr: - **Fiscal space narrows.** Budget absorbed for energy means less for other items, or the deficit has the potential to widen.

segments.src: Sebagai gambaran kasar, sensitivitas APBN terhadap harga minyak bekerja di dua sisi.
segments.tr: As a rough illustration, the sensitivity of the APBN to oil prices works on two sides.

segments.src: Penerimaan dari minyak dan gas bumi memang ikut naik, tetapi pada umumnya kenaikan belanja subsidi dan kompensasi lebih besar daripada tambahan penerimaan.
segments.tr: Revenue from oil and gas does indeed rise, but generally, the increase in subsidy and compensation spending is greater than the additional revenue.

segments.src: Besaran pastinya bergantung pada asumsi makro, kurs rupiah, dan volume konsumsi, sehingga sebaiknya merujuk pada publikasi resmi Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: The exact amount depends on macro assumptions, the rupiah exchange rate, and consumption volume, so it is best to refer to official publications from the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: ### Peran nilai tukar rupiah
segments.tr: ### The role of the rupiah exchange rate

segments.src: Minyak diperdagangkan dalam dolar AS.
segments.tr: Oil is traded in US dollars.

segments.src: Jika harga minyak naik sementara rupiah melemah, tekanan menjadi berlapis: harga dalam dolar naik dan kurs yang dipakai untuk membayarnya juga lebih mahal.
segments.tr: If oil prices rise while the rupiah weakens, the pressure becomes layered: the price in dollars rises and the exchange rate used to pay for it is also more expensive.

segments.src: Inilah sebabnya pergerakan kurs perlu dipantau bersamaan dengan harga Brent.
segments.tr: This is why exchange rate movements need to be monitored alongside Brent prices.

segments.src: ## Jalur kedua: ongkos angkutan dan logistik
segments.tr: ## Second pathway: transportation and logistics costs

segments.src: Sektor logistik di Indonesia sangat bergantung pada truk berbahan bakar solar, ditambah kapal antarpulau dan angkutan udara.
segments.tr: The logistics sector in Indonesia is highly dependent on diesel-fueled trucks, plus inter-island ships and air transport.

segments.src: Bahan bakar merupakan salah satu komponen biaya operasional terbesar, sering disebut mencapai porsi yang signifikan dari total ongkos angkut.
segments.tr: Fuel is one of the largest operational cost components, often cited as reaching a significant portion of total shipping costs.

segments.src: Dampaknya dapat bergerak melalui beberapa tahap:
segments.tr: The impact can move through several stages:

segments.src: 1. **Biaya operasional pengangkut naik**, terutama bagi pengguna solar nonsubsidi atau bahan bakar industri.
segments.tr: 1. **Carrier operational costs rise**, especially for users of non-subsidized diesel or industrial fuel.

segments.src: 2. **Tarif angkutan disesuaikan**, biasanya dengan jeda waktu setelah harga bahan bakar berubah.
segments.tr: 2. **Transportation tariffs are adjusted**, usually with a time lag after fuel prices change.

segments.src: 3. **Harga barang di tingkat konsumen terdorong naik**, khususnya komoditas yang jalur distribusinya panjang, seperti pangan segar dan bahan bangunan.
segments.tr: 3. **Prices of goods at the consumer level are pushed up**, especially commodities with long distribution chains, such as fresh food and building materials.

segments.src: 4. **Wilayah kepulauan menanggung dampak lebih besar**, karena rantai pasok lebih panjang dan bergantung pada angkutan laut dan udara.
segments.tr: 4. **Archipelagic regions bear a greater impact**, because supply chains are longer and depend on sea and air transport.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha kecil dan menengah, kenaikan ongkos kirim menggerus margin bila harga jual tidak bisa serta-merta dinaikkan.
segments.tr: For small and medium-sized business owners, rising shipping costs erode margins if selling prices cannot be immediately raised.

segments.src: ## Kaitan dengan inflasi dan daya beli
segments.tr: ## Link to inflation and purchasing power

segments.src: Kenaikan ongkos logistik pada akhirnya dapat menambah tekanan inflasi, terutama komponen harga bergejolak (volatile food) dan transportasi.
segments.tr: Rising logistics costs can ultimately add to inflationary pressure, especially in volatile food and transportation components.

segments.src: Jika inflasi naik, Bank Indonesia bisa menghadapi pertimbangan yang lebih rumit dalam menentukan arah suku bunga, sementara rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah paling sensitif terhadap kenaikan harga kebutuhan pokok.
segments.tr: If inflation rises, Bank Indonesia may face more complex considerations in determining the direction of interest rates, while low-income households are most sensitive to rising prices of basic necessities.

segments.src: ## Apa yang bisa dilakukan
segments.tr: ## What can be done

segments.src: **Pemerintah dan otoritas**
segments.tr: **Government and authorities**

segments.src: - Menjaga keseimbangan antara perlindungan daya beli dan disiplin fiskal, misalnya lewat subsidi yang lebih tepat sasaran.
segments.tr: - Maintain a balance between protecting purchasing power and fiscal discipline, for example through more targeted subsidies.

segments.src: - Menjaga kelancaran pasokan dan distribusi agar gangguan harga tidak diperparah masalah ketersediaan barang.
segments.tr: - Maintain the smoothness of supply and distribution so that price disruptions are not exacerbated by problems with the availability of goods.

segments.src: - Mempercepat diversifikasi energi, seperti biodiesel, gas, dan kendaraan listrik, untuk mengurangi ketergantungan jangka panjang pada minyak impor.
segments.tr: - Accelerate energy diversification, such as biodiesel, gas, and electric vehicles, to reduce long-term dependence on imported oil.

segments.src: **Pelaku usaha**
segments.tr: **Business players**

segments.src: - Mengoptimalkan rute dan muatan untuk menekan konsumsi bahan bakar per unit barang.
segments.tr: - Optimize routes and loads to reduce fuel consumption per unit of goods.

segments.src: - Mempertimbangkan kontrak angkutan dengan klausul penyesuaian bahan bakar agar risiko dibagi secara wajar.
segments.tr: - Consider transportation contracts with fuel adjustment clauses so that risks are shared fairly.

segments.src: - Memantau harga acuan dan kurs sebagai indikator awal perubahan biaya.
segments.tr: - Monitor benchmark prices and exchange rates as early indicators of cost changes.

segments.src: **Konsumen**
segments.tr: **Consumers**

segments.src: - Mengantisipasi kemungkinan penyesuaian harga barang tertentu dan merencanakan pengeluaran dengan lebih hati-hati.
segments.tr: - Anticipate the possibility of price adjustments for certain goods and plan expenditures more carefully.

segments.src: ## Hal yang perlu dicermati ke depan
segments.tr: ## Things to watch moving forward

segments.src: Harga minyak sangat dipengaruhi faktor yang sulit diprediksi, mulai dari pasokan global, permintaan, hingga dinamika geopolitik.
segments.tr: Oil prices are heavily influenced by factors that are difficult to predict, ranging from global supply and demand to geopolitical dynamics.

segments.src: Lonjakan sekitar 4 persen dalam waktu singkat belum tentu bertahan.
segments.tr: A spike of about 4 percent in a short time may not necessarily last.

segments.src: Yang lebih penting adalah apakah harga bertahan tinggi dalam jangka menengah, karena itulah yang menentukan seberapa besar tekanan pada subsidi dan logistik.
segments.tr: What is more important is whether prices remain high in the medium term, because that is what determines how much pressure there is on subsidies and logistics.

segments.src: Indikator yang layak dipantau:
segments.tr: Indicators worth monitoring:

segments.src: - Pergerakan Brent dan ICP dibandingkan asumsi APBN.
segments.tr: - Brent and ICP movements compared to APBN assumptions.

segments.src: - Kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS.
segments.tr: - The rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar.

segments.src: - Perkembangan harga solar dan LPG serta kebijakan penetapannya.
segments.tr: - Developments in diesel and LPG prices and their setting policies.

segments.src: - Data inflasi bulanan, terutama komponen transportasi dan pangan.
segments.tr: - Monthly inflation data, especially transportation and food components.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Brent di kisaran US$108,50 per barel mengingatkan bahwa perekonomian Indonesia masih terhubung erat dengan pasar energi global.
segments.tr: Brent in the range of US$108.50 per barrel reminds us that the Indonesian economy is still closely connected to the global energy market.

segments.src: Dampaknya berjalan lewat dua pintu utama: beban subsidi dan kompensasi di APBN, serta ongkos angkutan yang merambat ke harga barang.
segments.tr: The impact runs through two main doors: the burden of subsidies and compensation in the APBN, and transportation costs that creep into the prices of goods.

segments.src: Respons yang terukur dari pemerintah, kesiapan pelaku usaha, dan kewaspadaan konsumen akan menentukan seberapa jauh guncangan harga ini terasa.
segments.tr: A measured response from the government, the readiness of business players, and consumer vigilance will determine how far this price shock is felt.

id-20260930-intro-retail-12.title: [Retail #12] Order on Your Phone, Pick Up at the Convenience Store: Why Stores and Apps Must Become One?

segments.src: > Omnichannel bukan soal punya banyak kanal jualan, melainkan soal membuat semua kanal itu terasa seperti satu toko yang sama bagi pelanggan.
segments.tr: > Omnichannel is not about having many sales channels, but about making all those channels feel like the same store to customers.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda punya tiga cara berjualan: toko fisik di pinggir jalan, akun di marketplace, dan chat WhatsApp.
segments.tr: Imagine you have three ways to sell: a physical store on the roadside, an account on a marketplace, and WhatsApp chat.

segments.src: Kalau ketiganya berjalan sendiri-sendiri — stok beda, harga beda, promo beda, dan kasir toko tidak tahu apa yang pernah Anda beli lewat aplikasi — itu namanya **multichannel**.
segments.tr: If all three run independently — different stock, different prices, different promotions, and the store cashier doesn't know what you've bought through the app — that's called **multichannel**.

segments.src: Banyak kanal, tapi tidak nyambung.
segments.tr: Many channels, but they don't connect.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** melangkah satu tingkat lebih jauh: semua kanal berbagi data yang sama, sehingga pelanggan bisa berpindah kanal tanpa mengulang dari nol.
segments.tr: **Omnichannel** takes one step further: all channels share the same data, so customers can switch channels without starting from scratch.

segments.src: Sederhananya:
segments.tr: In short:

segments.src: Multichannel = banyak kanal, data terpisah
segments.tr: Multichannel = banyak kanal, data terpisah

segments.src: Omnichannel  = banyak kanal, satu data pelanggan + satu data stok
segments.tr: Omnichannel  = banyak kanal, satu data pelanggan + satu data stok

segments.src: Ada tiga fondasi yang biasanya dibahas di kuliah ritel:
segments.tr: There are three foundations usually discussed in retail classes:

segments.src: 1. **Satu tampilan pelanggan (single customer view).** Riwayat belanja, poin loyalitas, dan keranjang yang belum di-checkout dikenali di kanal mana pun. Anda menambahkan barang ke keranjang di aplikasi pagi hari, lalu buka situsnya di laptop kantor — keranjangnya masih ada.
segments.tr: 1. **Single customer view.** Purchase history, loyalty points, and abandoned shopping carts are recognized across any channel. You add an item to your cart in the app in the morning, then open the website on your office laptop — the cart is still there.

segments.src: 2. **Satu tampilan stok (unified inventory).** Sistem tahu barang yang Anda cari habis di gudang pusat tapi masih ada dua unit di cabang Bandung. Tanpa ini, "cek stok online" cuma tebakan, dan pesanan sering dibatalkan sepihak.
segments.tr: 2. **Unified inventory.** The system knows the item you're looking for is out at the central warehouse but still has two units at the Bandung branch. Without this, "checking stock online" is just a guess, and orders are often canceled unilaterally.

segments.src: 3. **Konsistensi harga dan layanan.** Harga, promo, dan aturan retur idealnya seragam. Kalau tidak, pelanggan merasa "dihukum" karena memilih kanal yang salah.
segments.tr: 3. **Consistency in price and service.** Prices, promotions, and return policies should ideally be uniform. If not, customers feel "punished" for choosing the wrong channel.

segments.src: Istilah **O2O (Online to Offline)** adalah jembatan praktisnya: aktivitas online yang sengaja diarahkan menuju transaksi atau pengalaman di dunia fisik — dan sebaliknya.
segments.tr: The term **O2O (Online to Offline)** is its practical bridge: online activities intentionally directed toward transactions or experiences in the physical world — and vice versa.

segments.src: Bentuk paling umum di ritel Indonesia adalah *click & collect* alias BOPIS (*buy online, pick up in store*): bayar lewat aplikasi, ambil barang di gerai terdekat.
segments.tr: The most common form in Indonesian retail is *click & collect*, or BOPIS (*buy online, pick up in store*): pay through the app, pick up the item at the nearest store.

segments.src: Kenapa peritel repot-repot melakukan ini?
segments.tr: Why do retailers bother doing this?

segments.src: Karena perilaku belanja sudah tercampur.
segments.tr: Because shopping behavior is now mixed.

segments.src: Ada **ROPO** (*research online, purchase offline*) — riset di internet, beli di toko.
segments.tr: There's **ROPO** (*research online, purchase offline*) — research online, buy at the store.

segments.src: Ada juga kebalikannya, *webrooming* dan *showrooming*: melihat barang langsung di toko, lalu memesan lewat ponsel sambil masih berdiri di depan raknya.
segments.tr: There's also the opposite, *webrooming* and *showrooming*: viewing items directly at the store, then ordering via phone while still standing in front of the shelf.

segments.src: Pelanggan tidak berpikir dalam istilah "kanal"; mereka cuma ingin barangnya.
segments.tr: Customers don't think in terms of "channels"; they just want the product.

segments.src: Manfaat nyatanya ada tiga: biaya pengiriman turun (ambil sendiri di gerai lebih murah daripada kurir ke rumah), tingkat pembatalan pesanan berkurang (karena stok terlihat akurat), dan ada *cross-selling* saat pelanggan datang mengambil barang.
segments.tr: There are three concrete benefits: shipping costs decrease (picking up at the store is cheaper than courier delivery), cancellation rates drop (because stock appears accurate), and there's *cross-selling* when customers come to pick up items.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Sabtu pagi di Jakarta.
segments.tr: Saturday morning in Jakarta.

segments.src: Anda butuh *rice cooker* pengganti karena yang lama rusak.
segments.tr: You need a replacement *rice cooker* because the old one broke.

segments.src: Anda buka aplikasi sebuah jaringan toko elektronik.
segments.tr: You open an electronics store chain's app.

segments.src: Harganya Rp 480.000, tapi Anda ragu — mau lihat wujudnya dulu.
segments.tr: It costs Rp 480,000, but you're hesitant — you want to see it in person first.

segments.src: Aplikasinya menampilkan "Tersedia di gerai Kelapa Gading: 3 unit".
segments.tr: The app shows "Available at Kelapa Gading store: 3 units".

segments.src: Anda pilih **ambil di toko**, bayar lewat QRIS, lalu berangkat sore hari.
segments.tr: You choose **pickup at store**, pay via QRIS, then head there in the afternoon.

segments.src: Di kasir, Anda cukup menunjukkan kode pesanan.
segments.tr: At the cashier, you just show your order code.

segments.src: Petugas tahu Anda anggota sejak 2023 dan poinnya otomatis bertambah — tidak perlu daftar ulang, tidak perlu menjelaskan bahwa Anda sudah bayar.
segments.tr: The attendant knows you've been a member since 2023 and your points automatically increase — no need to re-register, no need to explain that you've already paid.

segments.src: Seandainya jaringan toko itu masih multichannel, ceritanya jadi berbeda: aplikasi bilang "tersedia", Anda datang ke gerai, stok ternyata kosong karena sistem gudang online dan kasir toko tidak saling bicara.
segments.tr: If the store chain were still multichannel, the story would be different: the app says "available", you come to the store, the stock is actually empty because the online warehouse system and the store cashier don't communicate.

segments.src: Anda pulang dengan tangan kosong — dan pindah ke penjual lain.
segments.tr: You go home empty-handed — and switch to another seller.

segments.src: Contoh lain yang lebih dekat lagi: minimarket.
segments.tr: Another even closer example: convenience stores.

segments.src: Anda pesan lewat aplikasi minimarket dengan opsi ambil di gerai dekat kos, atau minta diantar oleh layanan ojek daring dari gerai yang jaraknya 700 meter.
segments.tr: You order through the convenience store app with the option to pick up at the store near your boarding house, or request delivery by a ride-hailing service from a store 700 meters away.

segments.src: Toko fisik di situ berubah fungsi — bukan cuma tempat berjualan, tapi juga **gudang mikro** untuk pengiriman cepat.
segments.tr: The physical store there changes function — not just a sales location, but also a **micro-warehouse** for fast delivery.

segments.src: Inilah yang disebut *store as fulfillment center*, dan ini alasan kenapa jaringan gerai yang padat justru jadi keunggulan besar di era belanja online, bukan beban.
segments.tr: This is called *store as fulfillment center*, and this is why a dense network of stores becomes a major advantage in the online shopping era, not a burden.

segments.src: Ujian sesungguhnya biasanya muncul saat retur.
segments.tr: The real test usually comes at returns.

segments.src: Kalau barang yang dibeli lewat aplikasi bisa dikembalikan di gerai fisik mana pun tanpa drama, peritel itu sudah benar-benar omnichannel.
segments.tr: If items purchased through the app can be returned at any physical store without hassle, the retailer is truly omnichannel.

segments.src: Kalau jawabannya "maaf Kak, itu pesanan online, urusnya beda departemen" — berarti kanalnya masih terpisah, betapapun mulusnya aplikasi mereka.
segments.tr: If the answer is "sorry, that's an online order, it's handled by a different department" — it means the channels are still separate, no matter how smooth their app is.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Multichannel berarti punya banyak kanal; omnichannel berarti kanal-kanal itu berbagi satu data pelanggan dan satu data stok.
segments.tr: 1. Multichannel means having many channels; omnichannel means those channels share one customer data and one inventory data.

segments.src: 2. O2O seperti click & collect menghubungkan dunia online dan gerai fisik, menurunkan ongkos kirim sekaligus mengurangi pesanan batal.
segments.tr: 2. O2O like click & collect connects the online world and physical stores, reducing shipping costs while decreasing canceled orders.

segments.src: 3. Toko fisik tidak mati — ia berubah peran menjadi titik pengambilan, titik retur, dan gudang mikro untuk pengiriman cepat.
segments.tr: 3. Physical stores don't die — they change roles to become pickup points, return points, and micro-warehouses for fast delivery.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Assessment Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah peritel punya toko fisik, situs web, dan akun marketplace, tetapi stok dan poin loyalitas dikelola terpisah di masing-masing kanal.
segments.tr: **1.** A retailer has a physical store, a website, and a marketplace account, but inventory and loyalty points are managed separately on each channel.

segments.src: Ini contoh dari?
segments.tr: This is an example of?

segments.src: - (A) Omnichannel
segments.tr: - (A) Omnichannel

segments.src: - (B) Multichannel
segments.tr: - (B) Multichannel

segments.src: - (C) Single customer view
segments.tr: - (C) Single customer view

segments.src: - (D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: - (D) Endless aisle

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Istilah ROPO menggambarkan pelanggan yang mencari informasi produk secara online lalu membelinya di toko fisik.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) The term ROPO describes customers who research product information online and then buy it at a physical store.

segments.src: **3.** Manakah yang **bukan** manfaat langsung dari layanan click & collect (BOPIS) bagi peritel?
segments.tr: **3.** Which is **not** a direct benefit of click & collect (BOPIS) service for retailers?

segments.src: - (A) Ongkos pengiriman per pesanan lebih rendah
segments.tr: - (A) Lower shipping cost per order

segments.src: - (B) Peluang penjualan tambahan saat pelanggan datang ke gerai
segments.tr: - (B) Additional sales opportunity when customers visit the store

segments.src: - (C) Margin produk otomatis naik tanpa perubahan harga
segments.tr: - (C) Product margin automatically increases without price changes

segments.src: - (D) Pemanfaatan gerai sebagai titik pemenuhan pesanan
segments.tr: - (D) Using stores as order fulfillment points

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terminology

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — strategi ritel yang mengintegrasikan seluruh kanal penjualan dan layanan sehingga terasa sebagai satu pengalaman utuh bagi pelanggan.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — a retail strategy that integrates all sales channels and services to feel like a single cohesive experience for customers.

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — memiliki beberapa kanal penjualan yang beroperasi terpisah, dengan data dan kebijakan masing-masing.
segments.tr: - **Multichannel** — having multiple sales channels that operate separately, each with their own data and policies.

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — praktik mengarahkan aktivitas atau transaksi digital menuju pengalaman di lokasi fisik, dan sebaliknya.
segments.tr: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — the practice of directing digital activities or transactions toward experiences at physical locations, and vice versa.

segments.src: - **Click & Collect / BOPIS** — pelanggan memesan dan membayar secara daring, lalu mengambil barangnya sendiri di gerai.
segments.tr: - **Click & Collect / BOPIS** — customers order and pay online, then pick up the item themselves at the store.

segments.src: - **ROPO (Research Online, Purchase Offline)** — perilaku mencari informasi produk secara daring sebelum membeli di toko fisik.
segments.tr: - **ROPO (Research Online, Purchase Offline)** — the behavior of researching product information online before buying at a physical store.

segments.src: - **Unified inventory** — satu basis data stok yang dipakai bersama oleh semua kanal, sehingga ketersediaan barang terlihat akurat di mana pun.
segments.tr: - **Unified inventory** — a single inventory database shared by all channels, so product availability appears accurate everywhere.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1 — (B) Multichannel; kanalnya banyak, tetapi data stok dan loyalitas tidak menyatu, sehingga pengalaman pelanggan terputus saat berpindah kanal.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1 — (B) Multichannel; there are many channels, but inventory and loyalty data don't merge, so customer experience breaks when switching channels.

segments.src: 2 — O (benar); ROPO adalah riset daring lalu pembelian di gerai, kebalikan dari showrooming.
segments.tr: 2 — T (true); ROPO is online research followed by purchase at the store, opposite of showrooming.

segments.src: 3 — (C); BOPIS memang menekan ongkos kirim, membuka peluang cross-selling, dan memaksimalkan fungsi gerai, tetapi margin produk ditentukan oleh harga jual dan harga pokok — bukan oleh metode pengambilan barang.*
segments.tr: 3 — (C); BOPIS does reduce shipping costs, opens cross-selling opportunities, and maximizes store functions, but product margin is determined by selling price and cost price — not by the pickup method.*
